## What's new

- **Folder listing (opt-in).** Press Ctrl+F, click `[folder: off]` in the status line, or use the line in Settings. While it
  is on, each request also carries the names, types and sizes of the entries in the current folder, so *"extract the
  archive"* becomes `tar -xzf backup-2026-10.tar.gz` for the archive that is actually there. File contents, hidden entries,
  subfolder contents and the folder path are never sent. Off by default; the choice is kept, and `context.folder = true`
  in the config file sets the starting value. See [Folder listing](https://github.com/hungryZoo/howtui#folder-listing).
- Sign-in notice, `--help` and README privacy section now describe the folder listing.

## Install or update

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hungryZoo/howtui/main/scripts/install.sh | sh     # Linux, macOS
```

```powershell
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hungryZoo/howtui/main/scripts/install.ps1 | iex           # Windows
```

Running the installer again updates in place; sign-in, model choice and shell integration stay as they are.

## Verify

`sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS --ignore-missing` and `gh attestation verify <file> --repo hungryZoo/howtui`.
Binaries are not code-signed or notarized.
